name: schema-change-notes
description: After every successful schema deployment, writes plain-language release notes of what changed for the team, and points out skills and knowledge documents that mention fields that are gone.

howItWorks.label: Compares
howItWorks.text: The new schema with the one it saw after the previous deployment

howItWorks.label: Writes
howItWorks.text: Release notes: what is new, what changed, what was removed and what that means for the team

howItWorks.label: Checks
howItWorks.text: Skills and knowledge documents that still mention removed or renamed fields

howItWorks.label: Posts
howItWorks.text: The notes to Slack, if you pick a channel

plugins.reason: Posts the release notes to a channel

parameters.label: Written for
parameters.description: team explains changes in terms of the work; developers also gives entity and field names and types

parameters.label: Check skills and documents
parameters.description: Look for skills and knowledge documents that mention removed or renamed fields

parameters.label: Slack channel
parameters.description: Optional; without it the notes stay in the run notification
